title: Newton's Law of Cooling — Purpose & Real-World Applications
notes: This law lets you predict exactly how fast an object will cool down over time
**Forensics:** estimates a victim's time of death by measuring body temperature decay
**Engineering:** designs safe cooling systems for car engines, computers, and nuclear reactors
**Food industry:** determines how quickly cooked food or pasteurized milk must be chilled
**Everyday life:** predicts how long a cup of coffee stays warm in a cold room
